observations.content: SuperBased Observer is a local Go tool that captures, normalizes, compresses, and analyzes AI coding-assistant activity while providing accurate token tracking and on-demand project knowledge.
SuperBased Observer is a local-first Go tool for capturing, normalizing, and analyzing tool-call activity from AI coding assistants such as Codex, Cursor, Cline, Copilot, OpenCode, and others.
It includes an API proxy for accurate token and cost tracking, plus a multi-layer compression pipeline for reducing noisy shell output and conversations.
The tool also exposes an MCP server that lets assistants query project knowledge on demand.
